marble.name: The Vikings
marble.subject: History
marble.description: Who the Vikings were: seafaring warriors and traders from Scandinavia; longships; Viking raids on Britain; that Vikings also settled and farmed
marble.prompt: Could you tell you who the Vikings were, where they came from, and that they did more than just raid and fight?

representations: Map of Scandinavia, the North Sea and Britain with arrows
Role cards: raider, trader, settler, farmer
Two helmet pictures: the Gjermundbu Viking Age helmet and a stage costume with horns
authoredAnswer: Vikings were seafaring people from Scandinavia (Denmark, Norway, Sweden). The coin and scales suggest buying, selling and trading. No: Vikings also traded, settled in England (in the area later called the Danelaw) and most were farmers at home, as well as raiding.

wrongAnswers.revealedBy: Describes the coin and scales as stolen loot only and cannot name any non-raiding role. Evidence basis: National Museum of Denmark, The people of the Viking Age.. This is an authored observable performance/reasoning chec
wrongAnswers.fix: Return to the role-and-evidence match and ask what most Vikings did at home and what traders needed scales for.

wrongAnswers.revealedBy: Draws or describes horned helmets as standard Viking equipment when talking about who Vikings were. Evidence basis: National Museum of Denmark, Viking Age helmets. documents this as a common claim; the child-voice wordin
wrongAnswers.fix: Show the Gjermundbu helmet and a horned opera costume side by side and ask which was dug up from a Viking Age grave.
